package_name: OT - BACnet - Inhibit Response Function Pack (MITRE)
description: Official MITRE CALDERA for OT BACnet abilities for validating behaviors intended to prevent operators or safeguards from responding. Provides 6 Morgana Scripts for ATT&CK for ICS Inhibit Response Function with verified protocol assets where required; CALDERA is not required at runtime.
author: MITRE (converted by X3M.AI for Morgana)
prerequisites: Morgana agent installed on an explicitly authorized execution host
Required OT facts supplied as Morgana tag values; no target defaults are provided
Required assets downloaded from Camelot and verified by SHA256
capabilities: Provides official MITRE CALDERA for OT BACnet behaviors for ATT&CK for ICS Inhibit Response Function.
Exercises behaviors intended to prevent operators or safeguards from responding against an operator-supplied BACnet simulator, lab, or approved target.
Uses verified package assets and protocol-specific parameters where required (2 unique assets in this pack).
use_cases: Validate BACnet monitoring, industrial telemetry, and ATT&CK for ICS detection coverage.
Run focused Inhibit Response Function exercises in an isolated OT lab or cyber range.
Assess whether defensive controls distinguish read-only protocol activity from process-changing behavior.
safety_notes: Highest operational risk in this pack: DISRUPT. Review the risk badge on every Script before execution.
No target values are supplied; configure only an explicitly authorized lab, simulation, or approved production exercise.
Verified assets are downloaded only when a Script is explicitly executed; importing the pack never contacts an OT target.

scripts.id: OT - BACNET - T0816 - BACnet Reinitialize Device - Cold Start [Linux/Bash]
scripts.name: OT - BACNET - T0816 - BACnet Reinitialize Device - Cold Start [Linux/Bash]
scripts.description:
BACnet Service:   Reinitialize Device Service Category: Remote Device Management
The ReinitializeDevice service is used by a client BACnet-user to instruct a remote device to do one of the following behaviors: reboot (cold start), reset to another predefined initial state (warm start), activate network port object changes, or to control the backup or restore procedures. 
Possible state values:
  0=coldstart
  1=warmstart
  ...
scripts.cleanup_command: printf '%s\n' '[INFO] T0816 cleanup: upstream ability provides no cleanup command'
